fact: On 12 August 2021 in Bangui the MINUSCA police component (UNPol) handed the Direction des services de Police judiciaire a fully rehabilitated database room and a batch of IT and office equipment costing 16,000,000 CFA francs, in support of the plan de renforcement des capacités et de développement des Forces de sécurité intérieure; the director then asked for an archiving system and IT training for staff.
title: Bangui : Opérationnaliser la Direction des Services de Police Judiciaire
publisher: Nations Unies Maintien de la paix / MINUSCA
